faqs.question: Does QR code generator & Wi-Fi card upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. QR code generator & Wi-Fi card executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/image/qr-tool-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate QR code generator & Wi-Fi card?
